engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Sensör okuma hatası veya tesisat temassızlığı
stepByStepSolution: 1. VCDS / ODIS ile canlı veri grupları taranır.
2. Tesisat ve voltaj beslemeleri test edilir.
3. Gerekirse OEM yedek parça ile yenilenip adaptör sürüşü yapılır.
technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Mk6 Golf (PQ35) based models using a  09-Cent. Elect./BCM (J519) module that contains Component: PQ35 Kontrol edin: the fuse that powers terminal T52b/1 at J519.  If the fuse is blown or Terminal 30 power is not getting to T52b/1 the vehicle will have this DTC in addition to inoperative Rear wiper, Dual washer pump, Fuel Tank Flap and Central Locking for boot.
Kontrol edin:  the AW1 Comfort system wiring diagram for that terminal at J519 instead of the Standard equipment diagram since it is "comfort" function specific.
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: Polo based (PQ25) based models using a  09-Cent. Elect./BCM (J519) module that contains Component: PQ25/BCM25 Kontrol edin: the fuse that powers terminal T73a/16 at J519.
Kontrol edin:  the AW0 Comfort system wiring diagram for that terminal at J519.
This is fuse SC36 on most of the NAR market VW models mentioned above however VIN specific Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri diagrams and Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları arrangements can be obtained from erWin directly: Official Factory Repair Information.
